findings.text: issue (blocking): §5 tells build to call loom-code:review when this is the last wave, before execution reaches §6.5, while §6.5 says the memory work must precede that same closing round; following the numbered sections causes the post-review memory commit Acceptance 1–2 eliminate.
findings.fix: Move the final-wave review call after package tests and the memory step, or make §5 defer the last-wave call until §6 and §6.5 have completed; name the resulting call scope: branch-end when the final wave-end round doubles as branch-end.

findings.text: issue (blocking): build requires the plan's reserved last-wave memory task, but write-plan and its plan template never require or create it; a future plan reaches §6.5 without a valid task id and any graduated-test commit fails push.dispatch-covers-tasks.
findings.fix: Add the reservation to write-plan's plan-shape contract and plan template, or make build create the task and dispatch record through a documented mechanism.

findings.text: issue (blocking): the station-text tests prove only that the memory heading precedes hand-off, not that it precedes the final-wave review call in §5, so the sequencing contradiction stays green.
findings.fix: Add a structural test requiring package tests, then §6.5 memory work, then exactly one closing review call recorded as branch-end.

findings.text: nitpick (non-blocking): the duplicated graduated-probe guard is position-blind — it accepts the first status: line anywhere in the document.
findings.fix: Parse only the top metadata block; add a synthetic with a body-level status: closed before the real one; same in the branch_end copy.

notes: --list-rules returned 27. Pytest could not start in the read-only sandbox (no writable temp dir). The §4 and §5 trailer commands are semantically sound for merge, docs-only, code and missing-trailer cases.

findings.text: issue: §6.5 asserts "the plan reserves one" memory task, but write-plan's Task DAG / Shape sections carry no such instruction; a future plan following §6.5 literally has no Task id for the trailer and push.dispatch-covers-tasks blocks.
findings.fix: Add a sentence to write-plan's Shape section reserving a last-wave memory task, or soften §6.5 and state what to do when none exists.

findings.text: nitpick: the skip guard returns on the first status:-prefixed line anywhere in the file; safety rests on intent files opening with frontmatter.
findings.fix: Restrict the scan to the leading frontmatter block — optional.

notes: Ran the delta's test files (119 passed, 2 skipped) and both probe files (23 passed); widened cap measured at 75 words; --list-rules 27; loom_checker.py absent from the diff. §6.5 scopes the memory step to the round that closes the plan; ship §1/§3/§3.5 and Acceptance 1 consistent once branch-end reviewed_sha is read as the latest before push.
